claims.statement: Exact max{durable margin, (k+1)-disjoint-support bottleneck margin} for connected tree supports.
claims.condition: finite explicit host tree, nonempty connected dependency supports, rectangular weakening envelope
claims.prior_art: classical subtree/chordal theory; no standalone novelty promotion

claims.statement: Exact minimum evidence acquisition cost with a per-leaf checker cap by durable single witness versus min-cost k+1 disjoint subtrees.
claims.condition: nonnegative additive acquisition cost, bounded per-witness leaf check, explicit host tree
claims.prior_art: weighted chordal independent-set methods; exact same-scope novelty unresolved

claims.statement: Complete 2^s branch acceptance or counterexample for s supplied exceptional components.
claims.condition: after deleting supplied exceptional components, every residual support is empty or a subtree
claims.mechanism: exception-subset case distinction plus subtree minmax

claims.statement: Every resilient collection contains resilient subcollection of at most M(s,k)=sum_j binom(s,j)(k-j+1) rows; an optimal nonnegative-cost collection may meet same size bound; M(1,1)=3 sharp.
claims.prior_art: could follow from standard branching/packing; non-author subsumption check required

claims.statement: Deterministic minimum worst-case signed positive-receipt check cost equals sum of cheapest k+1 leaf prices.
claims.condition: fixed adversarial failure set before queries, disjoint supports, no change manifest, deterministic zero error, requires fresh signed YES

claims.statement: Equal-price minimax expected signed checks with independent randomization equal (n+1)/(n-k+1).
claims.condition: fixed adversarial failure subset, randomized zero error, equal costs, signed yes output
claims.mechanism: negative-hypergeometric first success and Yao symmetrization

falsification_edges: One disconnected dependency support invalidates the subtree packing equality.
Incomplete authenticated update manifest invalidates source-to-version transfer.
Unmodeled common-cause failures can invalidate simultaneous evidence rows.
A global minimal shared-evidence selection problem for multiple hazards remains NP-hard even for k=0.
Real-world correctness of margin lower bounds is not certified by combinatorial checkers.
current_assessment: No worldwide novelty, external peer review, Lean terminal compilation, or real-system safety certificate established.
next_test: Matched-contract replay on independently inspected versioned agent guard; compare true proof-checking resource costs and measure smallest legitimate exception set.
